name: i18n.md
html:
core/i18n.ts

Locale registry and URL-slug tables.
Source src/core/i18n.ts
UX surface Shared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

_RAW_LANG_OPTIONS

Language picker rows (unfrozen source for LANG_OPTIONS). cc/cc2 are ISO country codes the split-flag renderer paints side-by-side — dialects spanning two cultures get two halves (Hunsrik = German/Brazilian, Talian = Italian/Brazilian, Castellano and Portuñol straddle AR/UY/BR). es-ga/es-ct are region-qualified codes for Galicia/Catalonia whose flags the renderer draws as striped variants. short is the 2-letter chip label; omitted means "uppercase the code".

LANG_OPTIONS

Language picker rows with short defaulted to the uppercased locale code (PT stays 'PT', EN becomes 'EN').

(module scope)

One language-picker row — element type of LANG_OPTIONS, derived from the frozen array so the type can never drift from the data.

VALID_LANGS

Ordered list of routable locale codes — drives detectLangFromPath and the CMS locale switcher. Order matches LANG_OPTIONS (picker order).

(module scope)

Localized route slugs for one locale — every navigable page key maps to its translated path segment (about → 'sobre'/'ueber', …).

about

'//about' segment.

contact

Contact page segment.

privacy

Privacy-policy page segment.

gdpr

GDPR page segment.

terms

Terms-of-use page segment.

earthPlayground

Earth playground segment.

(module scope)

Localized route slugs per locale — the path segments after the locale prefix. English is canonical/un-prefixed; every other locale maps its routes through this table (/br/sobre, /de/nutzungsbedingungen, …). CMS may override these at runtime via translations/<loc>/slugs.

detectLangFromPath

Extracts the locale segment from a URL path; defaults to English when the first segment isn't a valid locale code. /de/ueber → 'de', /about → 'en' (English is the un-prefixed default).

  • @param pathname - location.pathname
  • @returns locale code from LOCALES

localePath

Builds a localized URL for a route key ('about', 'privacy', …). English paths stay un-prefixed (/about); other locales get //. Unknown keys fall back to the raw key — localePath('portfolio/x', 'fr') → /fr/portfolio/x.

  • @param key - route key matching a LANG_SLUGS field, or a raw slug
  • @param lang - locale code
  • @returns absolute path
